texts.name: Marlous
texts.biography: Marlous is an extremely obedient Gremlin. He accepted his slavery as if it were perfectly natural. His good fortune was to belong to a powerful mage who placed him at the head of a small army of Gremlins... Then his talents were recognized throughout Bracada as that of a powerful Gremlin leader...

specialty.name: Gremlins
specialty.description: Increases the speed of any Gremlins, Master Gremlins and Assistant Gremlins by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 10% for every 1 levels (rounded up).
